title: Maximal volume of convex bodies avoiding random points and lacunary dilates
summary: For a positive real lacunary sequence and any probability measure $μ$ with polynomial Fourier decay, we determine, for $μ$-almost every $x$, the asymptotic maximal volume of convex bodies avoiding the first $N$ dilates of $x$ modulo $\mathbb Z^d$. Among homothets of a fixed convex body, the maximal volume is asymptotic to $(\log N)/N$. When all convex bodies in the unit cube are allowed, it is asymptotic to $d(\log N)/N$. For independent uniform points in a fixed convex body $Ω\subset\mathbb R^d$, the maximal volume of an empty convex body is asymptotic to $d\operatorname{vol}(Ω)(\log N)/N$…
